messages:
Claira: Heads-up — preparing console rollout to surface SLO thresholds as notifiers. We need a final decision on per-tenant notify routing vs global default. Ping @Henry for routing policy.
Henry: We should default to tenant-level contacts when present, else fall back to org-level webhook. Keeps least surprise.
Samir: +1 but how do we handle noisy tenants? Sampling vs suppression?
Claira: two levers: sampling (rate limit alerts) and quiet-windows. I want API contract that returns both `notify_targets` and `suppress_profile` in /slo-exposure.
Mika: returning structured `suppress_profile` will break current notify-preview UI — need migration. Can we add a compat shim?
Henry: compat shim ok, but prefer flagged rollout. Add `notify_preview_v2` behind feature flag.
Samir: telemetry — we need per-route breakdown (sent, suppressed, sampled) to attribute cost. Metric names? maybe `slo.notify.count{outcome=sent|suppressed|sampled}`
Claira: perfect. Also add token-level cost tag.
devex-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/948 — adds /slo-exposure v2 + feature flag.
Mika: I'll review tomorrow. We should plan canary: 5% tenants first, monitor spikiness for 24h.
Henry: add alert if suppression rate > 30% for canary tenants.
Samir: question: in canary, do we allow automatic fallback to global notify if tenant contacts misconfigured?
Claira: yes — fallback path should be `global_webhook` with audit log entry and metric `slo.notify.fallback`.
Henry: also add UI hint showing "Last fallback at <time>" and link to runbook.
Samir: can we surface a "preview" button that simulates notifications for tenants? devex-bot can run a dry-run.
devex-bot: dry-run endpoint: POST /internal/notify/dry-run — returns sample payload.
Mika: make sure dry-run logs are suppressed in prod; only kept 7d. Security asks.
Claira: noted. I'll update RFC and the rollout checklist. Anyone want to be on-call for first 48h? @Mika?
Mika: I can rotate on-call first 48h.
Henry: I'll own telemetry dashboards.
Samir: I'll make the sampling config UI.
Claira: thanks all — I'll land the feature-flag PR once reviews in. :thumbsup:
